Senses.Explanation: A preface is introductory prose attached to a record, collection, or scripture edition. Xu Fu, Lin Zhifan, Xiong Kaiyuan, Yang Yi, Linquan Conglun, and Yongjue Yuanxian are each named in or by prefatory headings or signatures. Yunqi Zhuhong says directly that disciples requested a preface from him. Sanfeng Hanyue also uses the same graph verbally when a patron asks him to preface a scripture edition. Writing, requesting, signing, and titling all point to the same document; noun and verb grammar do not create separate senses.
Senses.Note: The document sense is supported by eight independent exact anchors. Title and surrounding metadata control this reading. The fixed institutional term for the two office divisions is excluded from this sense and retained only as a related term.
